description:
Dr. Martha Beck, Ph.D., a Harvard-educated sociologist, known as Oprah's life coach, bestselling author, and leading authority on personal growth, resolving childhood trauma and fixing anxiety. Dr. Beck provides practical tools and strategies to uncover your deepest desires, core truths, and the path to living your most authentic life. She believes that it's only through our authentic life that we can find all the things we're all searching for!
